extracted.intended_audience: AP journalists, editors, newsroom staff, and freelance contributors
extracted.subtask_description: High-level ethical standards and newsroom guidelines from The Associated Press covering accuracy, fairness, conflicts of interest, visuals, privacy, integrity, and conduct (including social media and freelance work). Intended to guide reporting and editorial decision-making to avoid bias and inaccuracies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report the news accurately and honestly
rubrics_metrics.description: It is our job — more than ever before — to report the news accurately and honestly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The AP states its long-standing role setting the industry standard for ethics in journalism; accuracy and honesty are the overarching obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telling the story
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists at The Associated Press utilize a set of standards and practices that safeguards AP stories from bias and inaccuracies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes the use of AP standards and practices in reporting to protect stories from bias and factual errors (page links to fuller guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: AP employees must avoid behavior or activities - political, social or financial - that create a conflict of interest or compromise our ability to report the news fairly and accurately, uninfluenced by any person or action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid actions that could create real or perceived conflicts; the page groups related subguidance (preventing favoritism, gifts, preventing bias, political activities, other work, freelance work) under this topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary featured guideline; full standards text is available via the linked guideline (no detailed text on this landing page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visuals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design and use of images/visual elements are identified as a distinct guideline area (details available on linked page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Decency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls out decency as a topical guideline for coverage and presentation (no further detail on this landing page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Privacy considerations are listed as a core guideline area for reporting (full guidance on linked page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrity is listed as a foundational guideline area governing AP conduct and reporting (see full guideline for specifics).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fabrications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prevention and handling of fabricated material is identified as a distinct guideline topic (details on linked resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing favoritism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed under featured guidelines and related to conflicts of interest; guidance likely covers avoiding preferential treatment in reporting and sourcing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gifts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gifts are highlighted as a concern under conflicts-of-interest guidance; full restrictions and examples are in the linked guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing bias
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit attention to preventing bias in reporting; page references fuller guidance elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AP employees' political activities are identified as a potential conflict area; see detailed rules on the linked guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on outside employment or activities that could affect AP reporting is listed (details on linked page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Freelance work
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific guidance for freelancers is provided as a featured topic (full text available via link).

rubrics_metrics.name: Social Media Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Social Media Guidelines (downloadable guideline referenced on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AP provides a separate social media guideline document covering conduct and use of social platforms by employees; this landing page links to that downloadable guidance.
